title: Christ Formed in Us
headline: The Point of It All: Christ Formed in You
headline_sub: Whose Image Is Becoming Recognizable in Me?
tagline: The battle was never merely about controlling your thoughts. It was about who you are becoming.
seo_title: The Goal of Spiritual Formation: Christ Formed in You (Galatians 4:19) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: The battle before the battle was never about thought management. It was about whose image your life reflects. A devotional for men on Galatians 4:19.
verse_text: My dear children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you….

scriptures.text: My dear children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you….
For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son….

items: Twenty days ago we began with a battle.

blocks.text: Now we arrive at the question underneath every other question:
Whose image is becoming increasingly recognizable in me?

items: The Battle Before the Battle was never ultimately about becoming excellent at thought management.
It wasn’t about becoming impossible to tempt.
It wasn’t about becoming endlessly self-aware.
It wasn’t about constructing a flawless version of yourself.

blocks.text: The destination was always: Christ formed in us.

sections.label: From the Beginning, This Was About Image

items: Genesis begins with humanity made in the image of God.
But God’s purpose does not end with forgiveness alone.
Romans 8:29: conformed to the image of His Son.
The gospel is not merely “God forgives bad people.”
God is forming a people who increasingly resemble His Son.
Diagnosis serves return. Return leads to remaining. Remaining leads to beholding. And beholding, by the Spirit, leads toward becoming.
You don’t return merely to become better at returning. You return to Christ.
Christlikeness does not erase personhood. It reorders personhood under Christ.
This isn’t a twenty-day technique. It is a way of walking with Jesus.
Recognize. Capture. Test. Surrender. Obey. Return. Remain. Behold. Become.
